title: Safe-FCL: Continual Risk Awareness and Fine-Grained Safety Aggregation for Federated Continual Learning of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.19968v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated fine-tuning enables large language models (LLMs) to learn collaboratively from distributed client data, but malicious client updates can compromise global model safety. As federated tasks evolve, changing malicious update patterns challenge the ability of existing defenses to maintain reliable risk detection over time. To address this challenge, we propose Safe-FCL, a framework integrating continual risk awareness with fine-grained safety aggregation for federated continual learning of LLMs. Specifically, the Continual Risk Awareness (CRA) mechanism learns emerging risk patterns across sequential tasks and constrains detector updates using a protective subspace derived from historical features, mitigating forgetting of previously learned malicious patterns while adapting to new risks. translated_title: Safe-FCL：面向大语言模型联邦持续学习的持续风险感知与细粒度安全聚合
translated_abstract: 联邦微调使大语言模型（LLM）能够从分布式客户端数据中协同学习，但恶意客户端更新可能会危害全局模型的安全性。随着联邦任务的不断演进，恶意更新模式的变化对现有防御机制长期维持可靠风险检测的能力构成了挑战。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了Safe-FCL，一个将持续风险感知与细粒度安全聚合相结合的大语言模型联邦持续学习框架。具体而言，持续风险感知（CRA）机制跨顺序任务学习新出现的风险模式，并利用从历史特征中导出的保护性子空间来约束检测器的更新，在适应新风险的同时缓解对先前所学恶意模式的遗忘。为了将风险感知转化为聚合层面的安全控制，细粒度安全聚合（FGSA）机制结合客户端级别的风险（信息进行安全聚合）。
tldr: 提出Safe-FCL框架，通过持续风险感知（CRA）机制跨任务学习新风险并保留历史恶意模式知识，结合细粒度安全聚合（FGSA）机制，解决大语言模型联邦持续学习中恶意更新模式不断演变导致防御失效的问题。
en_tdlr: Safe-FCL integrates a Continual Risk Awareness mechanism with Fine-Grained Safety Aggregation to reliably defend against evolving malicious client updates in federated continual learning of LLMs.
